If you do not agree, stop using and uninstall immediately.

data.name: ReportConfirm
data.value: The report will be copied to the clipboard, and a webmail page will open (QQ Mail when the manager language is Chinese; otherwise Gmail). Paste into a new message and send to llxmod@foxmail.com. False reports may affect review. Continue?

data.name: ReportSuccess
data.value: Report text was copied and webmail opened. Paste and send to llxmod@foxmail.com. If no page opened, email manually and paste from the clipboard.

data.name: ReportFailed
data.value: Could not open webmail or prepare the report

data.name: SubmitModConfirm
data.value: The submit template will be copied to the clipboard, and a webmail page will open so you can send it to llxmod@foxmail.com. Continue?

data.name: SubmitModSuccess
data.value: Submit template was copied and webmail opened. Paste, attach .dll (optional preview.png), and send to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: SubmitModFailed
data.value: Could not open webmail or prepare the submission

data.name: DirectUploadSecretHint
data.value: Enter these once. The manager writes them to .cos.yaml in your user profile for coscli. Leave the key blank to keep the saved one.

data.name: DirectUploadSecretSaved
data.value: Key saved to the local coscli config.

data.name: DirectUploadUpdateCatalog
data.value: Also update the catalog (master key only)

data.name: DirectUploadUpdateCatalogHint
data.value: Leave this off. Turning it on overwrites the mirror catalog, and only the master key on your PC can succeed. Do not turn it on for a sub-account key.

data.name: DirectUploadFilesUploaded
data.value: Files are in this mod's own folder. The catalog was not changed. Players can see it after the catalog is written.

data.name: DirectUploadCatalogDenied
data.value: Files were uploaded, but the catalog was not. A sub-account key cannot change the catalog. Write the catalog from your own PC.

data.name: DirectUploadCatalogWriteFailed
data.value: The catalog was not written. Use the master key on your PC. A sub-account key cannot change the catalog.

data.name: DirectUploadMergeSuccess
data.value: This mod is now in the catalog. Players can download it after refreshing.

data.name: DirectUploadEntryMissing
data.value: This mod has no entry on the mirror yet. Ask them to upload the files first.

data.name: DirectUploadSuccess
data.value: Catalog updated. Players can download it from the mirror after refreshing.

data.name: DirectUploadMirrorLagHint
data.value: Copy the same files into the GitHub repo MechabellumMods before a full mirror sync. Otherwise that sync overwrites this upload with the old catalog.

data.name: DirectUploadNotConfigured
data.value: This PC cannot write the domestic mirror. Install coscli and run coscli config init with an account that can write the mirror bucket.

data.name: DirectUploadNeedFields
data.value: Fill Id, name, and pick a DLL.

data.name: DirectUploadErrForbidden
data.value: Not allowed to update this mod (unowned or not yours).

data.name: DirectUploadErrGithub
data.value: GitHub write failed. Retry later or contact the maintainer.

data.name: DirectUploadErrNetwork
data.value: Network error. Check connection and retry.

data.name: SubmitGuideBody
data.value: Subject must start with one of these prefixes (copy-paste): • [Mod投稿/Submit] new mod • [Mod更新/Update] update existing • [Mod举报/Report] report • [管理器建议/Feedback] feedback One email = one request. Maintainers review and upload to the catalog — no Fork/PR required. (Advanced users may still open a PR.)

data.name: SubmitGuideTip
data.value: After you choose “Open submit email”, the manager copies the subject and body and asks whether to open QQ Mail or Gmail (Cancel keeps the clipboard only). Paste, attach .dll (optional preview.png), and send. For very large attachments (~over 40MB), put a cloud-drive link in the body. Do not send source code unless asked.

data.name: LogGamePathInvalid

data.name: DirtyHintDirty

data.name: StatusDetailReadyVersion

data.name: GuideIntro
data.value: Finish the first five steps to start a match. The rest is for after you have played. Read every line marked with the warning icon.

data.name: GuideLanguageBody
data.value: Pick it below. This page and the whole manager switch immediately. Follow system is also available.

data.name: GuidePathBody
data.value: The path in Settings must be the folder that contains Mechabellum.exe. If Setup already filled it in, just check it.

data.name: GuideLoaderBody
data.value: The middle of the top bar is the check result. Continue only when it says Ready. Otherwise Install/Upgrade MelonLoader appears on the right. The line under it is the diagnosis: whether anything is blocking the game.

data.name: GuideNoteMelon
data.value: Quit the game completely before installing.

data.name: GuideLaunchBody
data.value: The default is Steam first, then exe. If the loader did not inject, change it in Settings to Exe only.

data.name: GuideBrowseBody
data.value: On the top bar, open Workshop, pick a mod, and add it to the library. Adding it does not enable it. Then open Installed and check the ones you want.

data.name: GuideNoteRisk
data.value: Unchecked mods do not enter the game.

data.name: GuideLibraryBody
data.value: Check the mods you want on the Installed page.

data.name: GuideProfilesBody
data.value: The dropdown in the bar already has one profile. Create, rename, or duplicate only when you want more than one enable-set.

data.name: GuideApplyTitle
data.value: 5. Nothing reaches the game until you apply

data.name: GuideApplyBody
data.value: Checking a box only changes the profile. It does not write the game folder yet. If the bar says “Profile changed; game folder not synced — click Apply Profile”, it has not been written.

data.name: GuideNoteApply
data.value: Click Apply & Launch on the top bar: it writes the game folder, then starts the game. To write without starting, use Apply Profile.

data.name: GuideImportBody
data.value: On Installed you can import a dll, zip, or folder, or pull mods already in the game folder back into the library.

data.name: GuideUpdatesBody
data.value: Settings can turn on checking mod updates at startup. Hiding the Melon console takes effect the next time the game starts.

data.name: GuideBranchBody
data.value: The Game branches page can turn on two folders and switch between official and beta.

data.name: GuideNoteBranch
data.value: Do not turn this on the first time. Two folders need about two copies of the game. If you are unsure, keep a single folder.

data.name: GuideSupportBody
data.value: The line under the top status is the current diagnosis. If that is not enough, click Export Diagnostics in Settings, or beside the log at the bottom right. Send the zip to llxmod@foxmail.com, or report it on Discord (GODOG Battalion, https://discord.gg/CQDkCfDTA). Installers and source: https://github.com/llxlzx/MechabellumModManager

data.name: GuideCommunityBody
data.value: The top bar has Submit Mod. Report is on the individual entry. Direct upload needs an invite code and is not for most players.

data.name: GuideDismissStartup
data.value: Don't open this page on startup

data.name: PortableDataRoot
data.value: Portable data folder (data next to the app; restart required after change)

data.name: InstallMelonLoaderTip
data.value: Writes MelonLoader from the offline zip shipped with Setup (no GitHub needed)

data.name: ConfirmInstallMelonLoader
data.value: Install MelonLoader into the current game folder? Close the game first.

data.name: ConfirmUpgradeMelonLoader
data.value: Detected MelonLoader older than bundled 0.7.3. Overwrite-upgrade with the offline package into the current game folder? Close the game first.

data.name: NotifyMelonInstallNeedGamePath
data.value: Set a valid game path in Settings first.

data.name: LogMelonInstallDownload
data.value: No local offline package; trying GitHub download…

data.name: NotifyMelonInstallOk
data.value: MelonLoader installed. If assemblies are still missing, generate them when applying a profile.

data.name: SubmitGuideWaitNotice
data.value: The maintainer will review and process your message within a reasonable time. Handling may be briefly delayed due to daily life and personal schedule; thank you for your patience. Please do not resend the same request.

data.name: BranchSwitchBetaName
data.value: Beta name (default public_test; change only if needed)

data.name: BranchSwitchConfirmManual
data.value: I selected Test in Steam — continue

data.name: BranchSwitchHint
data.value: Three actions: Enable dual (one-shot; cancel/fail rolls back), Switch Official/Test, Restore Official folder. Needs about two installs. Default Steam beta name: public_test.

data.name: BranchStatusWizardPaused
data.value: Enabling (no pause/resume — cancel rolls back or wait)

data.name: BranchStatusEnablingWaitDownload
data.value: Enabling (waiting for Steam download; close rolls back)

data.name: StatusEnableDualWaitingDownload
data.value: Enabling: Steam is downloading the other branch (the game is not missing).

data.name: StatusEnableDualWaitingExitSteam
data.value: Other branch is downloaded: quit Steam from the tray, then archive continues.

data.name: NotifyModUpdateCloseGame
data.value: Close the game before updating a mod.

data.name: NotifyModUpdateBusy
data.value: A critical operation is running; mod updates are unavailable right now.

data.name: NotifyModUpdatesAvailable
data.value: {0} installed mod(s) can be updated: {1}. Update them under Browse Mods.

data.name: LogModUpdateCheckAllCurrent
data.value: Startup check: every installed mod is current.

data.name: CheckModUpdatesOnStartup
data.value: Check for mod updates on launch

data.name: HideMelonConsoleTip
data.value: Writes UserData\Loader.cfg (hide_console). Applies on next game launch; logs stay in MelonLoader\Latest.log. Do not close the console with X (that exits the game).

data.name: LogHideMelonConsoleRestartHint
data.value: Hide-console setting written; restart the game for it to take effect.

data.name: LogMelonConsoleHiddenHint
data.value: Hide Melon console is on: the black Melon window should not appear. Use MelonLoader\Latest.log and injection checks to confirm the loader.

data.name: LogMelonLaunchVerifyHiddenHint
data.value: Within ~30s the manager checks the game process and Latest.log. If not injected, switch launch mode to Exe only and export diagnostics.

data.name: TypePickPrompt
data.value: Could not detect the type automatically. Please choose:

data.name: ConfirmOverwriteUnmanaged
data.value: Unmanaged files with the same name already exist in the game folder. Overwrite and take over these files?

data.name: ConfirmBranchRebuildWizard
data.value: Official/Test dual folders are already enabled. To rebuild: use Restore Official folder first, then Enable dual again. Continue?

data.name: ConfirmBranchTeardown
data.value: Remove Official/Test dual-folder setup? The manager will switch to Official first, then remove dual folders. Steam will use the Official folder again. Exit Steam and the game first.

data.name: ConfirmEmergencyRecoverSingle
data.value: This restores the official game folder (Steam will keep only one Mechabellum folder). Junctions/hollow shells are removed and files are moved back from a complete folder when possible. The next dialog asks whether to delete the extra game folder. Exit Steam and the game first. Continue?

data.name: ConfirmEmergencyRecoverSingleOfficialMissing
data.value: This restores the official game folder (Steam will keep only one Mechabellum folder). This can only collapse the folder that still exists into a single Mechabellum. It cannot recreate Official. Official is missing or incomplete — wait for Steam to finish downloading Official. Do not switch folders or uninstall now. Continue only keeps the current folder. Continue?

data.name: NotifySteamWritingDoNotTouchStores
data.value: Steam is writing the game folder. Wait until Start is available. Do not click Restore Official folder, do not switch folders, and do not uninstall the manager until then.

data.name: ConfirmOrphanDualRepair
data.value: This restores the official game folder (Steam will keep only one Mechabellum folder). Dual-branch is off, but a directory junction and/or leftover folders remain. Restore a single Mechabellum folder (materialize if still a junction; if Mechabellum is hollow and another folder is complete, move that folder back and rename the hollow debris to Mechabellum_incomplete_*). The next dialog asks whether to delete the extra folder. Exit Steam and the game first. Continue?

data.name: ConfirmBranchDeleteOtherStore
data.value: Also delete the other branch’s separate game folder? This cannot be undone. Yes: delete now so you can run the dual-folder wizard again immediately. No (recommended): keep the folder; current play is unaffected. To enable dual-folder later, delete it manually or re-run Setup cleanup.

data.name: NotifySteamStillRunningSettle
data.value: Steam is still running. If the download finished, you can confirm settle (snapshot only reads the manifest).

data.name: ConfirmDeployWhileSteamRunning
data.value: Steam is still running. After download finishes, settle usually works — continue?

data.name: ConfirmDeleteProfile
data.value: Delete profile “{0}”? This cannot be undone.

data.name: ConfirmDeleteModFromLibrary
data.value: Remove “{0}” from the library? It will also be removed from all profiles.

data.name: ConfirmSwitchGameBranch
data.value: Switching Official/Test will exit Steam and the game, then change the folder link and Steam beta setting. Make sure Steam is not downloading/updating this game — forcing exit mid-download can break the Steam client. Continue?

data.name: ConfirmStartDualBranchWizard
data.value: Enable Official/Test dual folders (about two installs of disk space). Runs as one shot: archive current → download the other → link → settle. Cancel or failure rolls back to a single folder (no pause/resume). Exit Steam and the game first. Start?

data.name: ConfirmCurrentIsOfficial
data.value: Is the current install Official? Choose No if it is currently Test (Beta).

data.name: ConfirmDownloadOtherBranchContinue
data.value: Your current install was moved to a separate folder. Open Steam yourself to download the other branch (the manager will not auto-start Steam, to avoid the account picker). When finished, exit Steam, then click Yes. No pauses the wizard (you can resume later).

data.name: NotifySilentBetaFailedOther
data.value: Could not automatically set the other branch’s Steam test channel. Select it manually in Steam, then download.

data.name: LogDualBranchWizardPaused
data.value: Dual-folder wizard paused; you can continue later.

data.name: LogWizardAbortedReset
data.value: Enable dual aborted and rolled back to a single folder. Confirm the game folder is intact, then Apply & Launch.

data.name: LogEnableDualRolledBack
data.value: Cancelled enable dual and rolled back to a single folder.

data.name: LogEnableDualPendingEmergencySteamBusy
data.value: Enable dual was incomplete and Steam/game is still running, so disk rollback was skipped; session markers kept. Exit Steam, then use Restore Official folder.

data.name: NotifyEnableDualRollbackFailed
data.value: Enable-dual rollback did not fully succeed: {0}. Use Restore Official folder.

data.name: NotifyEnableDualRollbackSteamBusy
data.value: Steam or the game is still running, so disk rollback is unsafe. Session ownership was kept — quit Steam, then use Emergency recover to a single folder.

data.name: NotifyEnableDualAlreadyOn
data.value: Dual-folder is already enabled. To rebuild: Restore Official folder first, then Enable dual again.

data.name: LogMelonConsoleHint
data.value: For mods to load, MelonLoader should open a black Melon console (not PowerShell). If it does not, check version.dll / MelonLoader under the game folder and send MelonLoader\Latest.log.

data.name: LogLaunchRequestedVerifying
data.value: Launch requested; checking whether the game process starts…

data.name: LogLaunchStillWaiting
data.value: Still waiting for Steam to start the game; not treating this as a failure yet.

data.name: NotifyLaunchProcessNotSeen
data.value: Game process was not detected. Try Apply and launch again, or check whether Steam showed an account picker or blocked the start.

data.name: NotifyLaunchSteamStaleRunning
data.value: Steam still marks this game as running even though the process is gone (common after a crash or force-close), so it refused to start again. Fully quit the Steam client, reopen it, then click Apply and launch once. Do not click repeatedly.

data.name: NotifyLaunchGamePathMismatch
data.value: Steam opened a different game folder than the manager: {0}. Melon will not load in that window. Switch launch mode to Exe only, or set the manager path to the library Steam actually opened.

data.name: LogFirstAssemblyLaunchHint
data.value: First Melon launch is generating assemblies. A black screen or scrolling console is normal — wait a minute or two.

data.name: NotifyBranchTeardownDone
data.value: Dual-folder setup removed. In Steam, confirm the current game branch is correct.

data.name: NotifyApplySucceeded
data.value: Profile applied to the game folder

data.name: NotifySilentBetaNoStart
data.value: Could not automatically align the Steam test branch. Select the branch manually in Steam first; do not start Steam until it is aligned.

data.name: FeaturedModsHint
data.value: Select a card to see it in the list, then add it to your library

data.name: TipToggleHighRisk
data.value: Click to temporarily toggle the risk flag; after refresh it is re-evaluated from name keywords

data.name: TipDeleteFromLibrary
data.value: Remove this package from the library

data.name: PromptBetaBranchName
data.value: Enter the Steam beta/test branch name (usually public_test; not a folder path). Change only if it differs from Steam → Properties → Betas.

data.name: FailWizardNoBetaName
data.value: No test branch name entered; the wizard was cancelled.

data.name: FailWizardGamePathNotSteamCommon
data.value: The game path must be under steamapps\common\Mechabellum.

data.name: FailWizardInvalidGamePath
data.value: The current game path is invalid; cannot start the dual-folder wizard.

data.name: FailWizardOtherStoreExists
data.value: The other branch’s separate folder already exists; cannot archive: {0}. Use Restore Official folder first, or check “also delete the other store” on a pure restore (cannot undo).

data.name: FailWizardOtherStoreIncomplete
data.value: The other branch folder exists but is incomplete (missing GameAssembly etc.): {0}. Exit Steam, delete that incomplete folder, then continue the wizard — do not keep clicking Continue.

data.name: FailWizardOtherStoreLinkConflict
data.value: Other branch folder {0} is complete, but the Steam link path is still a real directory. The manager will not auto-delete game folders. Use Clear isolation in Settings, or exit Steam and resolve the leftover, then restart the wizard.

data.name: FailWizardSteamLinkExists
data.value: Steam link path is still occupied (real folder or wrong junction); cannot create the directory link. Clear isolation in Settings, or exit Steam and fix …\common\Mechabellum, then continue.

data.name: FailWizardGamePathIsBranchStore
data.value: Game path is a dual-branch store (Mechabellum_official / Mechabellum_beta) and the Steam link folder Mechabellum is missing. Move/restore the active store to …\common\Mechabellum (or verify/reinstall the game), then retry the wizard. Re-running the manager Setup can also auto-fix.

data.name: LogWizardNormalizedStorePath
data.value: Normalized game path from store "{0}" to Steam link "{1}".

data.name: NotifyBranchTeardownLeftoverStores
NotifyBranchTeardownLeftoverStoresResidual
FailOrphanSteamLinkNotGameRoot
data.value: Steam path Mechabellum is not a complete game root (missing exe / GameAssembly, etc.), and auto-restore from a leftover folder failed. Exit Steam, check for complete Mechabellum_official / Mechabellum_beta under …\common\, then use Restore Official folder; or run Setup cleanup / Steam verify.

data.name: FailOrphanSteamLinkHollowNoDonor
data.value: Steam path Mechabellum is hollow (incomplete), and no complete leftover store (Mechabellum_official / Mechabellum_beta) was found nearby. Use Steam “Verify integrity of game files” or reinstall to repair Mechabellum.

data.name: FailWizardNoAppManifest
data.value: appmanifest_669330.acf not found; cannot align the Steam test branch.

data.name: FailWizardCannotReadManifest
data.value: Cannot read the Steam manifest (may need elevation or a library move): {0}

data.name: FailWizardArchiveCurrentFailed
data.value: Failed to archive the current branch folder.

data.name: FailWizardArchiveOtherFailed
data.value: Failed to archive the other branch folder.

data.name: FailWizardCreateLinkFailed
data.value: Failed to create the directory link.

data.name: NotifyWizardDoneWaitingSteam
data.value: Dual-folder wizard finished. Open Steam yourself if you need download/verify (the manager will not auto-start Steam). When ready, return to Settings and click the gold “…Continue” button to finish settle.

data.name: LogSteamForceCloseClient
data.value: steam://exit had no effect (common with the “Who’s playing?” account picker); force-closing Steam client processes…

data.name: LogSteamOrGameStillRunning
data.value: Steam client or the game is still running (including steamwebhelper). Close Steam windows (including the “Who’s playing?” account picker) and the game, then try again; background steamservice can stay.

data.name: NotifyOpenSteamManuallyForSettle
data.value: Open Steam yourself to finish download/verify if needed. The manager will not auto-start Steam (avoids the account picker). When Steam shows Play, return to Settings and click the gold “…Continue” button to finish settle. OK only closes this tip.

data.name: NotifyManagerAlreadyRunning
data.value: The manager is already running. Use the existing window.

data.name: NotifyOpenSteamManuallyForWizardDownload
data.value: Open Steam yourself to download the other branch; the manager will not auto-start Steam.

data.name: NotifyWizardWaitingDownloadAuto
data.value: Waiting for the other branch download: open Steam yourself and download. When finished, fully exit Steam (tray → Exit); the manager continues automatically. OK only closes this tip. Closing the manager or cancelling enable rolls back to a single folder (no pause/resume).

data.name: TaskMessageWizardWaitingExitSteam
data.value: Other branch download complete: fully exit Steam (tray → Exit); the wizard continues automatically after exit

data.name: LogWizardDownloadAutoContinue
data.value: Other branch download looks complete and Steam is closed; continuing dual-folder wizard automatically.

data.name: LogSettleSnapshotNoAutoSteam
data.value: Steam manifest snapshot restored; no need to auto-start Steam. When the game is ready, click the gold “…Continue” button in Settings to finish settle.

data.name: NotifyAlreadyOnGameBranch
data.value: Already on this branch (folder and Steam beta are aligned). No switch needed.

data.name: NotifyAlignedButGameIncomplete
data.value: Folder and Steam branch keys are aligned, but the game path is not ready yet (missing binaries or MelonLoader incomplete). Wait for Steam to finish download/verify, then retry.

data.name: HintActiveStoreIncompleteSwitchOther
data.value: If the other branch folder is still complete: fully exit Steam, then switch to that branch — or use Restore Official folder to restore from the complete folder. Steam rewrites the active folder through the Mechabellum junction; do not force operations mid-download.

data.name: FailBranchStoreIncompleteSteamDownload
data.value: The active branch folder is incomplete (often Steam downloading/verifying; GameAssembly.dll missing). Exit Steam, then switch to the complete other folder, or use Restore Official folder to restore from the complete folder; or wait until Steam finishes.

data.name: NotifySettleBlockedGameNotReady
data.value: Game path is not ready; cannot finish settle deploy. Wait for Steam download/verify, then confirm again.

data.name: NotifySettleBlockedDeployFailed
